stacking_rules.economic_multipliers: apply floors first, then percentage bonuses
stacking_rules.xp_multipliers: sum additive percentage bonuses unless explicitly specified, then apply to earned XP before rounding

synergies.name: Negotiation Powerhouse
synergies.effect: Known Commodity first floors Contract II/III at the Elite band. Great Negotiator then applies +20% to that resulting offer. This is intentionally one of the strongest economic combinations and costs all 5 of the player's 6 slots.

synergies.name: Accelerated Superstar Path
synergies.effect: Player begins at Star, earns +15% XP, and receives dev-promotion challenge checks 50% more often until X-Factor. Costs all 6 slots, so the player sacrifices every other natural gift.

synergies.name: Franchise Builder
synergies.effect: Faster XP acquisition can be diverted to Team XP from Season 1. This accelerates teammate development but necessarily slows the Immortal's own ratings growth whenever XP is diverted.

synergies.name: Natural Burner
synergies.effect: SPD/ACC receive the premium Naturally Fast discount while AGI/COD receive Quick Feet discounts. No extra hidden percentage is added; the cascade comes from covering four elite movement ratings. Costs 4 slots.

synergies.name: Deep-Speed Specialist
synergies.effect: For WR/TE, the largest applicable discount applies first and overlapping SPD-related discounts stack at 50% effectiveness, subject to the universal 30% maximum discount on any one rating.

synergies.name: Student of the Game
synergies.effect: LB only. Mental-rating discounts stack using diminishing returns and remain capped at 30%. IQ-derived starting values are never modified.
